prompt: how can i learn a language alone and faster? (including the basic principles of languages: writting, speaking, reading and listening)
judge_reasoning: All candidates give broadly relevant self-learning strategies and touch the four skills, but they differ in completeness, solo-leaning alignment, and factual reliability. Candidate 1 is the most balanced and practically organized, explicitly addressing writing, speaking, reading, and listening with coherent study methods and fewer questionable factual/statistical claims. Candidate 2 covers all skills well but includes multiple likely-false or unsupported quantitative assertions (e.g., specific percentages/timelines), which reduces trust. Candidate 3 and 4 are less well aligned to learning “alone” (more reliance on clubs/communities or external help) and Candidate 4 particularly under-addresses reading; both also include some dubious claims, so they score lower.
